groups.sentence: Instructors make clear that original, personal student work is what counts for assessment.
All work students submit in this course is expected to be their own.
Students submit only work that is entirely their own and original.
Students do not present AI-generated output or work they did not produce as their own.
Submitted work reflects the student's own understanding, thinking, voice, effort and skills.
Students are responsible for the content of their submissions and for ensuring the work is their own.
Work students submit is assumed to be their own original work unless identified otherwise.
By submitting work, students attest that they are its only and original author.
Students complete assignments without help from AI or other external tools.
Students do their own work and properly cite any sources they use.
Students revise and personalize AI-generated content and do not submit it as-is.
Even when AI use is allowed, the final work submitted must still be the student's own.
Students keep ownership of their core ideas, arguments and analysis.
Passing off work that is not one's own as one's own is dishonest, and students remain its authors.
